about: Hand-labelled evaluation set for the exact checks in code. Each case lists what a brand reviewer applying the demo Brand Kit should flag (rule ID and the quoted words) and which claims should be verified against approved facts. Labels were written from the Brand Kit rules, not from the engine's output. The brand and all facts are fictional.
